description: A grand castle made of silver with gates of gold, silver, and brass, glimmering under the sun.
A young boy, Per, standing with a cat in front of a small cottage, deciding to take the cat with him on a journey.
insertAfter: vilde han have noget, saa maatte det blive Katten.

description: Per presenting a large reindeer to the kitchen of the king's castle, where the king looks pleased and inquiring.
insertAfter: og da han saa det store gilde Rensdyret blev han vel glad.

description: A majestic moose entering the king's kitchen with Per, as the king's eyes widen in joy and astonishment.
insertAfter: Kongen kom strax ud i Kjøkkenet, og da han fik se det store gilde Elgsdyret, blev han saa glad at han ikke vidste hvad Fod han skulde staa paa.

description: A vast meadow filled with lush sheep, their wool nearly touching the ground, as seen by the king and Herreper.
insertAfter: Nu har jeg aldrig seet saa stor og vakker en Sauflok! Hvem eier den, vesle Gutten min?

description: A grand dining hall inside the silver castle where King and Herreper dine, filled with golden chairs and tables.
insertAfter: Men Per bad ham bie og spise til Kvelds med sig, og det gjorde da Kongen, men sur og grætten var han hele Tiden.

description: The magical moment when the cat transforms into a beautiful princess after Herreper reluctantly strikes it.
insertAfter: Men med det samme blev hun til den deiligste Prinsesse som nogen vilde se for sine Øine, saa Herreper blev ganske indtaget i hende.

description: A grand wedding ceremony taking place in the majestic silver castle, with Herreper and the princess celebrating.
insertAfter: Aa jo, det kan vel hænde at Herreper vilde have hende til Dronning.
